title: UAE corporate tax and free zones: what to check
description: Understand why a free zone licence does not automatically mean zero corporate tax, and what to prepare for a review.

sections.heading: A free zone licence is not a tax exemption
paragraphs: Qualifying Free Zone Persons can benefit from 0% corporate tax on qualifying income, subject to the applicable conditions. A free zone licence alone does not establish that status. Do not choose a company structure solely on a promised tax rate.

sections.heading: Prepare your business facts
paragraphs: For a useful review, describe your licensed activities, where customers and suppliers are located, the types of transactions you make, and your office and staffing arrangements. Bring your licence and available financial records.

Different income streams and transactions can receive different treatment. Ask a qualified tax adviser to assess your facts against current Federal Tax Authority guidance, including registration, filing and record-keeping requirements.

sections.heading: Questions before selecting a package
paragraphs: Ask what is included in the service: company formation, tax registration, bookkeeping, return preparation or a separate tax assessment. These are different tasks and should be identified in the written scope.
Expedia can discuss company-formation and tax-registration enquiries. A quotation should identify the work requested; it should not promise a tax outcome before reviewing the business.

sources.label: Federal Tax Authority: Free Zone Persons guide

title: UAE Golden Visa: preparing your enquiry
description: Choose the relevant Golden Visa category and prepare supporting information before requesting a quotation.

sections.heading: Start with the applicant category
paragraphs: Golden Residency is a long-term residence route for eligible applicants, with five- or ten-year durations depending on the category. Investors, entrepreneurs and specialised talent are among the categories described by the authorities. Eligibility and evidence differ between categories.

sections.heading: Tell us what you are applying under
paragraphs: Start with the emirate, your current residence status and the category you want assessed. For a property-based enquiry, clarify whose name appears on the ownership documents. A company name and an individual applicant name should not be treated as interchangeable.
After clarifying the category, we can identify the documents needed for review. Do not send account passwords, UAE Pass login details or one-time verification codes.

sections.heading: What your quotation should explain
paragraphs: The written quotation should identify the applicant, scope, total selling price and any exclusions such as insurance or separately payable items. VIP assistance must be described clearly; it does not replace authority approval.

The responsible authority decides eligibility and approval. Processing time depends on the category, document completeness and required appointments. We confirm the proposed service scope after reviewing the case.

title: Mainland or free zone: choosing for your business
description: Compare your activity, customers, premises and staffing needs before choosing a UAE business jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Choose around the work you will do
paragraphs: Begin with the actual activity you intend to carry out, where you will operate and who your customers are. The licensing authority and any additional approvals must fit those facts. A package name alone does not determine whether you can carry out a particular activity.

sections.heading: Compare the same requirements
paragraphs: Ask each option to cover the same activity, number of owners, premises needs and visa requirements. Compare renewal costs and exclusions as well as the initial quotation.
Check any requirements for work outside the chosen free zone with the relevant authority. Do not assume one licence permits every activity or every operating location.

sections.heading: Documents and practical arrangements
paragraphs: Prepare a short business description, proposed ownership structure and expected office and staffing requirements. The final document checklist follows the selected legal form and authority.
Company formation, residence applications, banking and tax matters have separate requirements. A licence should not be presented as a guarantee of a bank account, visa or tax treatment.

sections.heading: Ask for a reasoned recommendation
paragraphs: Expedia can review your intended activity and prepare a quotation for the appropriate scope. Tell us whether your customers are local or international and whether you need premises or staff visas, so the comparison is useful to your case.

sources.label: UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism: establishing companies

title: PRO services in the UAE: preparing a clear request
description: A practical checklist for company and residency enquiries, documents, quotations and consultant handoff.

sections.heading: Tell us the service first
paragraphs: PRO support covers administrative assistance with business and government-related applications. To avoid unnecessary questions, begin with the service you need: a new application, renewal, amendment or cancellation. Tell us the emirate and whether the request concerns a company or an individual.

sections.heading: For a residency enquiry
paragraphs: Clarify whether the application is for an employee, employer or investor, or a dependant. These cases should not receive the same automatic price. The company category and personal circumstances may affect the documents and scope.
Once the service is clear, we can ask for the relevant documents and prepare an overall quotation. Insurance requirements and prices must be confirmed for the case rather than assumed.

sections.heading: Protect your documents
paragraphs: Provide only the documents requested for the identified service. Never share passwords or one-time login codes. Keep copies of submitted documents and references so follow-up can be tied to the correct application.

sections.heading: Know what happens next
paragraphs: Ask for a written scope, total price, exclusions and the next action. Our consultant can review the enquiry and confirm what is needed before work proceeds. Submission and approval are different stages; official approval remains with the responsible authority.

title: Privacy Policy
description: How Expedia handles website enquiries, contact information and technical website data.

sections.heading: Who operates this website
paragraphs: Expedia Business and Services L.L.C operates expediaservices.ae. Contact info@expediaservices.ae for questions about this notice or information you have submitted.

sections.heading: Information you provide
paragraphs: The enquiry form asks for your name, phone number, email, selected service and message. A residency enquiry may include the visa category you choose. The form also sends a request identifier to help prevent duplicate submissions.

Information you choose to provide through WhatsApp or email is also used to handle your enquiry. Avoid including passwords, payment-card details or unnecessary identity documents in a general website enquiry.

sections.heading: How enquiries are handled
paragraphs: We use enquiry information to respond, clarify requirements, prepare quotations and follow up on the requested service. Form submissions are sent to our business enquiry system, supported by Supabase, and may trigger a staff notification.

If you later engage a service, documents and information needed for that service are handled as part of that engagement. Information may need to be shared with the relevant authority or service provider to carry out the agreed work.

sections.heading: Website and communication providers
paragraphs: Hosting, delivery, security and measurement providers may process technical information such as IP addresses, request times, browser information and pages requested. The site uses Vercel and Cloudflare infrastructure and may request fonts from Google.

WhatsApp opens a separate service operated by Meta. Its handling of information is also subject to its own terms and privacy notice. Our handling of information received from you remains covered by this notice and the relevant service arrangements. Providers may process information outside your country.

sections.heading: Requests about your information
paragraphs: Contact info@expediaservices.ae to request access, correction or deletion of information you have provided. We may need to confirm your identity and review applicable record-keeping requirements before acting.
Information needed for ongoing services, dispute handling or required record keeping may need to be retained. Contact us if you need details about a particular record or request.

sections.heading: Updates
paragraphs: We may update this notice when the website or enquiry process changes. The review date shown on this page identifies this version.

title: Cookies and website technologies
description: Information about website storage, third-party requests and browser controls.

sections.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: Cookies are small pieces of information stored by a browser. Websites may also use other browser storage and make requests to outside services without setting a cookie.

sections.heading: Current website behavior
paragraphs: The website uses hosting and security infrastructure provided by Vercel and Cloudflare. Technical requests can include your IP address, browser information, requested page and request time. Security or service functions may use cookies or similar identifiers.

The website may make measurement and external font requests. A link to WhatsApp opens an external service with its own technology and privacy practices. This notice does not promise that all third-party processing is anonymous or cookie-free.

sections.heading: Browser choices
paragraphs: You can inspect, block or clear cookies and website storage in your browser settings. Blocking some technologies may affect page loading or service functions.

The site does not currently provide a separate analytics preference panel. Browser controls apply to your device; they do not prevent all server-side processing. Contact us if you need help understanding a specific request or cookie.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about website technologies or information handling, email info@expediaservices.ae. See the Privacy Policy for how enquiry information is handled.

title: Website Terms
description: Terms for using Expedia website information and requesting a service quotation.

sections.heading: Information on this website
paragraphs: This website describes services offered by Expedia Business and Services L.L.C. Guides provide general information and are not an individual legal, tax or immigration assessment. Requirements can change; confirm the applicable details before acting.

sections.heading: Quotations and service scope
paragraphs: A website enquiry is a request for information, not confirmation that an application is approved or that work has started. The written quotation or service agreement should identify the applicant or company, agreed scope, price, exclusions and payment arrangements.

Fees and timing depend on the specific service and case. Approval, banking decisions and government processing remain subject to the responsible organisations. A VIP service description does not guarantee an official outcome.

sections.heading: Information you submit
paragraphs: Provide accurate contact and case information and only submit documents you are entitled to share. Do not use the website to interfere with its operation or submit another person’s confidential information without appropriate authority.

sections.heading: External services
paragraphs: Links to government websites, WhatsApp and other external services are provided for convenience. Those services have their own terms and practices. Review them when using those services.

sections.heading: Questions or corrections
paragraphs: Contact info@expediaservices.ae about website errors, service questions or these terms. Specific engagements are governed by the agreed written scope and applicable requirements.
